items.source: /// A human-readable name for a tool entry, for reporting what was dropped.

items.name: tool_label
items.source:
fn tool_label(tool: &Value) -> String {
    let kind = tool
        .get("type")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .unwrap_or("function");
    tool.get("function")
        .unwrap_or(tool)
        .get("name")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .filter(|name| !name.is_empty())
        .map_or_else(|| kind.to_string(), |name| format!("{kind} ({name})"))
}
